items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Mike stepped out on the sidewalk, when we was leaving the bar, we were going on down to the bed. And I stepped out right, I was right behind Mike.

ctx.x: And everybody was giving them a little donation, so they asked Sid, and he didn't have any change on him. He didn't have any. So Mike McKendrick spoke of them and said, you should have some, if you don't get a hold of some, they'll be begging around here for you. And Sidney didn't like it. They had a big argument, and Mike and the bunch went, left there and went off to a place called Costa Bar. That's where we met, and we met over there. Mike was all in there drinking, in this Costa Bar that particular morning.…
